card.name: Absorbing Kid from the Sky
card.officialTextSummary: After this monster destroys another monster by battle and that monster is sent to the Graveyard, its controller gains 300 Life Points for each Level of the destroyed monster.

behavior.trigger: The source card itself must be the monster that destroyed the target by battle.
behavior.sourceVisibility: The source must be face-up when the battle destruction is established; a Set monster that flips face-up during the Damage Step may qualify.
behavior.destination: The destroyed monster must actually reach the Graveyard; banish, hand, Deck, Extra Deck, or remaining on the field do not qualify.
behavior.recipient: The source's current controller team, not its physical owner seat.
behavior.2v2: Apply recovery to one shared team Life Point total while retaining physical owner seat and UIDs for identity/audit.
behavior.sharedGate: Both cards require the source card to be the destroyer, battle destruction, face-up status at the destruction event, and actual destination in the Graveyard.

limitations: This primitive is not registered in monsterEffects.ts or duelEngineCurrent.ts.
No live Discord server interaction was performed.
Historical first TCG release is verified from the official database; OCG regional first-release reconciliation remains separate.
The helper resolves one already-established battle event; the duel engine must invoke it exactly once per distinct event.

relatedCards.name: Guardian Angel Joan
relatedCards.officialTextSummary: When this monster destroys another monster by battle and sends it to the Graveyard, it recovers LP equal to that monster's original ATK in the Graveyard.
